svg.title: Mitoitus planned layout: overview, focus, phone, wall and print
svg.desc: Planning wireframes. Desktop keeps a three-panel overview and opens one focused model. Phone stacks cards. Wall and print use reviewed stills and complete reference text.
svg.text: Planning wireframes — accepted drawing language, proposed application structure. Local only.
